posts.text:
Claude’s desktop app has a new Install as app feature. Web pages and mini-tools (Artifacts) that Claude creates for you can be installed as apps on Mac and Windows, with their own icons and windows.

I took a quick look at how it works. It’s a bit like Chrome’s Web Apps:
posts.quoted: You can now install Claude artifacts as desktop apps on Mac and Windows. Ask Claude to build an artifact, click "Install as app", and open it like any other app. It can use your connectors and, if you allow it, send notifications or add a menu bar item.
